commentary.text: 90+6' Rosario Abisso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.

90+1' Crossbar! Alberto Dossena (Como) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Jean Butez no chance!
88' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) is going to take the penalty!

87' Jean Butez (Como) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Juventus are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
86' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
86' Como couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
85' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement.
79' Lucas Da Cunha comes off the pitch to be replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fellipe Jack (Como) replaces Ignace Van der Brempt.
76' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Nicolas Gonzalez and he is replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
76' Good work from Como as they win a corner.
75' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
73' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
73' The substitution has been made. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) has replaced Assane Diao.
73' It's time for a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) comes on in place of Alex Valle.
70' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
67' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.
66' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
64' A substitution has been made. Patrick Cutrone is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Como).
61' The referee signals a substitution. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Manuel Locatelli.
61' Here is a change. Teun Koopmeiners is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
60' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.
58' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus).
58' Patrick Cutrone (Como) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
56' Rosario Abisso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nico Paz (Como).
56' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
55' Como have been awarded a corner kick.
52' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:1.

46' Nico Paz (Como) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
46' It is time for a substitution. Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) is on for Nicolo Savona.
46' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Referee Rosario Abisso points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Como players.
45+2' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an infringement in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Como players aren’t happy.

45+1' 1 - 1 Patrick Cutrone displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Assane Diao (Como) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it in off the crossbar – 1:1.
45' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
44' Nico Paz (Como) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
40' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle after Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
37' Alex Valle (Como) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

34' 0 - 1 What outstanding solo play by Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) as he slipped through inside the box to unleash a shot towards the net. He aimed perfectly and coolly fired it into the roof of the net.
34' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) will take a corner kick.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
25' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
25' Timothy Weah (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
23' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
23' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Michele Di Gregorio.
23' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
22' A clumsy foul by Weston McKennie (Juventus) and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle.
19' A cross into the box from Timothy Weah (Juventus) is cleared.
18' Rosario Abisso blows the whistle, Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) is penalised for a foul.
17' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
16' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
15' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
15' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) brings his opponent down. Rosario Abisso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.

11' Nico Paz (Como) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Michele Di Gregorio has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
6' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
5' Assane Diao (Como) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
3' The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
3' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Patrick Cutrone (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso is the one to supervise the game today.
